notes: Optional pre-deadline football intelligence consumed only by SZxP 2.2 Challenger.
Use player_id as the stable key.
Set gameweek to the target FPL Gameweek so a signal cannot leak into later weeks.
Tier A = official club/manager, B = trusted reporter, C = reliable aggregator, D = unverified rumour.
A signal must be timestamped. Expired signals are ignored.
This file is intentionally empty until a genuine pre-deadline signal is collected; never backfill rumours after a Gameweek to improve historical accuracy.
